bullets.text: Residents in Thiruvallur protested by surrounding the Poondi block development office, and the district team should monitor local administrative grievances.
Malaimurasu reported a land grab scam involving government lands at the Tiruttani Sub-Registrar office, prompting the district team to watch for revenue department actions.
Ambattur police inspected and destroyed ganja plants in the Pudur area, and the district team should follow up on local law enforcement updates.

takeaways: Residents besieged the Poondi block development office in Thiruvallur district today over unaddressed grievances.
District administration officials must intervene immediately to resolve public grievances and prevent further protests.
